Senior IT Supporter

_Are you passionate about technology, solving complex IT challenges, and delivering exceptional support to colleagues across the globe? Do you thrive in an international environment where no two days are the same, and where your expertise helps keep the business running smoothly? Then you might be our new Senior IT Supporter at PanzerGlass HQ.

_

PanzerGlass is globally recognised as one of the leading brands in screen protection. As our new Senior IT Supporter, you will play a key role in ensuring a stable, secure, and efficient IT environment across our global organisation. You will provide advanced IT support to users worldwide, contribute to infrastructure and improvement projects, and act as a trusted technical expert within the IT team.

Key responsibilities

You will be responsible for delivering high-quality IT support and helping drive continuous improvements across our global IT environment. Your responsibilities will include:

· Providing IT support to employees across multiple locations

· Handling and coordinating support tickets, escalations, and complex technical issues

· Supporting Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, endpoint management, hardware, and software platforms

· Managing onboarding, offboarding, user administration, and access rights

· Maintaining asset management processes and supporting device lifecycle management

· Supporting local offices and remote users worldwide

· Assisting with network, security, backup, and infrastructure-related tasks

· Driving process improvements, automation initiatives, and IT documentation

· Participating in IT projects, implementations, and system upgrades

· Mentoring colleagues and sharing technical knowledge across the team

· Collaborating with external vendors and service providers to ensure reliable IT services

Your profile

You have a solid technical foundation combined with a strong service mindset. You enjoy helping others, troubleshooting complex issues, and continuously improving the way things are done.

We imagine you bring:

· Relevant IT education or equivalent practical experience

· Minimum 3-5 years of experience in IT Support, IT Operations, or a similar role

· Experience supporting users within a global organisation

· Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, and endpoint management

· Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills

· A customer-focused and service-oriented approach

· Communication skills in English, both written and verbal

· A structured and detail-oriented way of working

· The ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

· A proactive and collaborative mindset

· A positive attitude with a "no job too big, no job too small" approach to work

We offer

· A company with best-in-class employee survey results – we are listed among the best workplaces in Denmark and Europe

· A culture of inclusivity and global collaboration, valuing and celebrating diverse perspectives

· An opportunity to join our trial for a 4-day working week

· A unique opportunity to join a global, fast-growing organisation

· Great opportunities for professional and personal development

· Professional and highly skilled colleagues who set the bar high

· Flexible working hours

Questions and application

We screen and interview candidates on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Due to GDPR regulations, we are unable to accept applications sent by email. Please submit your application on our Careers Page.

Start date: As soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Senior Finance Business Partner with focus on Mobility
jobs.description:
Picture yourself serving as a trusted advisor to the Danish management team in a global company, where your contribution can truly make a difference. Then imagine holding this meaningful position while working on what you do best – analysis, forecasting, and numbers.

Basico is recruiting a Senior Finance Business Partner on behalf of Circle K.

Allow us to bring the vision to life! At Circle K they are looking for you, with experience from similar roles - ready to step into this position and become part of our ambitious and highly skilled team in the Performance Management Analytics (PMA) department, based out of the Danish headquarter in Copenhagen, Sydhavn, Denmark.

It’s a numbers game – and you’ve mastered it

Circle K is one of the leading companies in Denmark in the convenience, energy, and fuel delivery sector. In Denmark, Circle K operates two different brands – Circle K and INGO – spread across 436 locations, with 211 of those operated under the Circle K brand.

As a part of Circle K’s PMA team, you will have 3 skilled colleagues you can consult with on financial matters. However, as you will be working with many different stakeholders, you will quickly learn that cooperation and collaboration across the organization is key – especially for this role.

As Senior Finance Business Partner, you will be the responsible sparring partner to both their Mobility and Sales department, translating numbers into actionable insights, building business cases, and much more. This involves sparring and partnering with the organization on matters such as fuel, E-Mobility, Car wash, B2B Customers, and more.

To be specific, your main responsibilities will be to:

· Partner with the Mobility and Sales department to create transparency in financial figures and drive qualified decision-making through fact-based recommendations.

· Work closely with the business to identify challenges and optimization opportunities.

· Analyze business performance and bring financial insights and recommendations to management.

· Improve and execute budgeting and forecasting processes within your area of responsibility, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and alignment with other areas.

· Analyze and explain developments in month-end figures.

· Build and review business cases.

· Communicate and present business cases and ad hoc analysis to management and other stakeholders.

Your business acumen makes you the preferred advisor

To be successful in this role, we imagine you have at least a few years' experience from a similar role. Since you are used to managing the interests of many different stakeholders, you have already tested your ability to work in a structured and proactive manner in an ever-changing environment, where balancing tasks is key to success.

You might hold a degree in Economics and Business administration, Accounting or Finance. Most important is however your authentic curiosity to understand causal relationships, developments, trends, and the willingness to dive into an Excel sheet full of numbers to grasp what is happening.

If you are an ambitious profile with solid understanding of finance processes, has an analytical mindset, and are motivated to make a difference, you will be a great match for the PMA team.

As sparring partner to the business, it is also important that you are able to simplify complex issues and present them with confidence to all levels in the organization in an inspiring way that makes people listen.

As you become part of an international organization where you advise colleagues from different countries, it is necessary that you are fluent in both English and Danish.

On the right path – Come join Circle K!

You will become part of an international organization in rapid development, working with many exciting initiatives redefining the future of Circle K’s business. Furthermore, when they say that diversity and sustainability are on the agenda, they mean it, and they care—also about future generations. Circle K have several initiatives they would love to tell you more about when you meet.

Circle K’s four core values—One Team, Do The Right Thing, Take Ownership, Play To Win—reflect the culture you will become a part of. When joining the PMA team, you will learn that humor, professionalism and a willingness to take responsibility are significant parts of the company’s DNA. If you have the same DNA, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Do you have all the facts you need to make your next move? Then send us your CV and application via the link below. We process applications confidentially and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Gitte Hjortskov Larsen, Director of Executive Search & Recruitment at Basico, by phone at +45 2510 2217.

At Circle K, there is room for everyone, and they always work together as One Team! Circle K value diversity and different ways of thinking and working. Therefore, they encourage everyone to apply for the position—regardless of age, gender, religion, disability, ethnic background, etc. What matters most to Circle K is who you are as a person, and what you bring to the team. We therefore encourage you not to include a photo on your CV.

Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To:

Technical Leadership

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

AI Services & Agentic Development

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

CI/CD & Reliability

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

Job Requirements:

Education & Experience

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

Technical Skills

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

Soft Skills

Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

About the Team

You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.
